tools.name: search_drugs
tools.title: Search Pakistan drug reference
tools.description: Search the LUMHS Ward Navigator's Pakistan brand-name drug reference by brand, generic, class, or indication keyword. Returns dosing summaries for common inpatient drugs.

query.description: Search term: brand name, generic name, class, or clinical use (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

tools.name: clinical_lookup
tools.title: Ask clinical reference assistant
tools.description: Ask the Ward Navigator's clinical reference assistant a concise, evidence-based question (differentials, red flags, investigations, management). Backed by the same AI used inside the app.

question.description: The clinical question, e.g. 'management of acute cholangitis in an adult'.
